stories.title: Turkish vessel to arrive in Karachi between Nov 17-20 to begin offshore oil, gas exploration
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: A Turkish seismic vessel will arrive in Karachi between November 17 and 20 to begin offshore oil and gas exploration, the Petroleum Division said on Friday.

stories.title: PM seeks roadmap for ‘100pc’ digital payments system, stresses countrywide internet access
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Friday directed authorities to prepare a “clear roadmap and time-bound targets” for establishing a 100 per cent digital payments system in the country.

stories.title: Turkish seismic vessel to reach Karachi in mid Nov for offshore oil, gas exploration
stories.brief: A Turkish seismic research vessel is expected to arrive in Karachi between November 17 and 20 to begin offshore oil and gas exploration, the Petroleum Division said on Friday, marking Pakistan's first major push to revive offshore exploration activities in two decades.

stories.title: PM directs authorities to map out cashless economy transition
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Saturday directed the relevant authorities to prepare a clear roadmap, with specific timelines and targets, for establishing a fully digital payment system across the country as the government steps up efforts to promote a cashless economy.

stories.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
stories.brief: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.

stories.title: A really simple guide to climate change
stories.brief: Human activities are causing the world to heat up, posing serious threats to people and nature.

stories.title: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult is sentenced to 200 years in prison
stories.brief: Cult leader Paul Mackenzie was convicted of murdering 190 children and one adult after he ordered his followers to starve themselves to death in order to meet Jesus.(Image credit: Brian Inganga)

stories.title: Elon Musk appears to signal the end of the road for Cybertruck
stories.brief: Musk said it was to make room for production of its Cybercabs - autonomous taxis without a driver.

stories.title: Delhi's toxic winter air is back - is the Indian capital prepared for pollution?
stories.brief: The Delhi government has announced a four-month winter action plan, but experts say that won't be enough.

stories.title: Imaan, Hadi move IHC against conviction in security breach case
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: Human rights lawyer Imaan Zainab Mazari-Hazir and her spouse Hadi Ali Chattha on Friday filed appeals in the Islamabad High Court (IHC) against their convictions by an anti-terrorism court in the security breach case.

stories.title: Gohar demands immediate implementation of SC order on Imran's medical treatment
stories.brief: Also Read: PTI seeks Imran's immediate transfer to Shifa International Hospital over renewed blood pressure concerns The remarks came amid renewed concerns within the PTI over Imran's health. She further said the Supreme Court's order requiring Imran's immediate transfer to Shifa International Hospital for medical treatment had not been implemented.

stories.title: Bilawal urges political parties to set aside differences, focus on economic crisis
stories.brief: Bilawal chaired a high-level meeting at Bhutto House in Naudero, which was attended by Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah, Chief Secretary Asif Haider Shah and members of parliament and senior government officials.

stories.title: Pakistan condemns Houthi missile attacks targeting Saudi Arabia's Makkah, Madinah
stories.brief: Pakistan steps up bilateral engagements The FO spokesperson said Pakistan intensified its diplomatic engagements with key international partners, with a series of high-level visits and meetings focusing on trade, investment, regional security and strategic cooperation.

stories.title: Imaan Mazari, Hadi Chattha appeal 10-year sentences in IHC
stories.brief: On October 29, an anti-terrorism court (ATC) sentenced Imaan and Hadi to 10 years in prison each in a case involving the removal of security barriers. On October 26, Imaan and Hadi approached the Supreme Court against an IHC decision concerning their request to halt proceedings in the anti-terrorism case.

stories.title: NADRA assistant director shot dead near office in Peshawar
stories.brief: On Tuesday, two policemen were martyred, and another was injured when unidentified armed men attacked a polio vaccination team in K-P's Mohmand district.

stories.title: What is net zero and is the UK on track to achieve it?
stories.brief: Reaching net zero carbon emissions worldwide is essential to limit global warming, UN scientists say.

stories.title: Could the US midterms burst the AI bubble?
